attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Kansas corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (post-Wayfair).

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets economic nexus threshold ($100K gross receipts or 200 transactions); result.ks_gross_receipts is greater than or equal to result.ks_economic_nexus_threshold

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Kansas state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. KS requires addback of federal interest income and state income tax refunds, with subtraction of Kansas municipal bond interest.

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Kansas state additions and subtractions; Calculate state-specific income adjustments
action_details.action_dsl: set result.ks_state_additions = 0.0; if result.ks_us_interest_income != 0.0 then set result.ks_state_additions = result.ks_state_additions + result.ks_us_interest_income; endif if result.ks_state_tax_refunds != 0.0 then set result.ks_state_additions = result.ks_state_additions + result.ks_state_tax_refunds; endif set result.ks_state_subtractions = 0.0; if result.ks_municipal_interest != 0.0 then set result.ks_state_subtractions = result.ks_state_subtractions + result.ks_municipal_interest; endif if result.ks_state_taxes_paid != 0.0 then set result.ks_state_subtractions = result.ks_state_subtractions + result.ks_state_taxes_paid; endif add (("Kansas additions: $" + string value of (result.ks_state_additions)) + ", subtractions: $") + string value of (result.ks_state_subtractions) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /result.ks_state_additions xdef { result.ks_state_additions result.ks_us_interest_income f+ cvd /result.ks_state_additions xdef } {} result.ks_us_interest_income 0.0 f== not ifelse { result.ks_state_additions result.ks_state_tax_refunds f+ cvd /result.ks_state_additions xdef } {} result.ks_state_tax_refunds 0.0 f== not ifelse 0.0 cvd /result.ks_state_subtractions xdef { result.ks_state_subtractions result.ks_municipal_interest f+ cvd /result.ks_state_subtractions xdef } {} result.ks_municipal_interest 0.0 f== not ifelse { result.ks_state_subtractions result.ks_state_taxes_paid f+ cvd /result.ks_state_subtractions xdef } {} result.ks_state_taxes_paid 0.0 f== not ifelse "Kansas additions: $" result.ks_state_additions cvs strconcat ", subtractions: $" strconcat result.ks_state_subtractions cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Kansas corporate income tax. Applies Kansas two-tier rate (4.0% base + 3.0% surtax on income over $50K) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has positive taxable income; result.ks_apportioned_income is greater than 0
Income exceeds $50,000 surtax threshold; result.ks_taxable_income is greater than result.ks_surtax_threshold

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Kansas tax with base rate + surtax (income over $50K); Apply 4.0% base + 3.0% surtax on income over $50K
action_details.action_dsl: set result.ks_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.ks_apportioned_income + result.ks_state_additions - result.ks_state_subtractions) and (0.0); set result.ks_base_tax = result.ks_taxable_income * result.ks_corp_tax_base_rate; set result.ks_surtax = (result.ks_taxable_income - result.ks_surtax_threshold) * result.ks_corp_tax_surtax_rate; set result.ks_tax_liability = the maximum of (result.ks_base_tax + result.ks_surtax - result.ks_state_credits) and (0.0); set result.ks_refund_or_owed = result.ks_estimated_payments - result.ks_tax_liability; add "Kansas taxable income: $" + string value of (result.ks_taxable_income) to job.audit_trail; add "Kansas base tax (4.0%): $" + string value of (result.ks_base_tax) to job.audit_trail; add "Kansas surtax (3.0% on excess over $50K): $" + string value of (result.ks_surtax) to job.audit_trail; add "Kansas tax liability: $" + string value of (result.ks_tax_liability) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: result.ks_apportioned_income result.ks_state_additions f+ result.ks_state_subtractions f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.ks_taxable_income xdef result.ks_taxable_income result.ks_corp_tax_base_rate fmul cvd /result.ks_base_tax xdef result.ks_taxable_income result.ks_surtax_threshold f- result.ks_corp_tax_surtax_rate fmul cvd /result.ks_surtax xdef result.ks_base_tax result.ks_surtax f+ result.ks_state_credits f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.ks_tax_liability xdef result.ks_estimated_payments result.ks_tax_liability f- cvd /result.ks_refund_or_owed xdef "Kansas taxable income: $" result.ks_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Kansas base tax (4.0%): $" result.ks_base_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Kansas surtax (3.0% on excess over $50K): $" result.ks_surtax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Kansas tax liability: $" result.ks_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Kansas tax - income $50K or less (base rate only); Apply only 4.0% base rate
action_details.action_dsl: set result.ks_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.ks_apportioned_income + result.ks_state_additions - result.ks_state_subtractions) and (0.0); set result.ks_base_tax = result.ks_taxable_income * result.ks_corp_tax_base_rate; set result.ks_surtax = 0.0; set result.ks_tax_liability = the maximum of (result.ks_base_tax - result.ks_state_credits) and (0.0); set result.ks_refund_or_owed = result.ks_estimated_payments - result.ks_tax_liability; add "Kansas taxable income: $" + string value of (result.ks_taxable_income) to job.audit_trail; add "Kansas tax liability (4.0%): $" + string value of (result.ks_tax_liability) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: result.ks_apportioned_income result.ks_state_additions f+ result.ks_state_subtractions f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.ks_taxable_income xdef result.ks_taxable_income result.ks_corp_tax_base_rate fmul cvd /result.ks_base_tax xdef 0.0 cvd /result.ks_surtax xdef result.ks_base_tax result.ks_state_credits f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.ks_tax_liability xdef result.ks_estimated_payments result.ks_tax_liability f- cvd /result.ks_refund_or_owed xdef "Kansas taxable income: $" result.ks_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Kansas tax liability (4.0%): $" result.ks_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No taxable income - no tax liability
